name: Sogetsu Hall
address: Tokyo 107-0052 Sogetsu Kaikan B1F, 7-2-21 Akasaka, Minato-ku
accessSummary: Aoyama-itchome Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza Line / Hanzomon Line, Toei Oedo Line) Minami-Aoyama Exit 4: 5 min walk / Akasaka-mitsuke Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza Line / Marunouchi Line) Exit A: 10 min walk
hours: There are three rental time slots: 9:00-17:00 / 13:00-22:00 / 9:00-22:00 (including time for preparation, cleanup and leaving the building). (Fee Table, April 2024)
notice: The hall is rented only to the extent that it does not interfere with use by the Sogetsu Foundation. On Saturdays, Sundays, holidays and substitute holidays, use for the whole day (9:00-22:00) takes priority. The contracted usage time cannot in principle be extended, and admission above the capacity of 526 is not allowed.

rooms.name: Sogetsu Hall
rooms.note: 526 fixed seats (capacity 526). The seating consists of 1F seats, 2F balcony seats and 3F balcony seats. The stage has a movable platform stage.

ops.prevDaySetup: The hall usage fee is 50% off when the hall is used for setup and rehearsals. (Fee Table, April 2024)
ops.loadingHours: The stage has one large-set load-in/out entrance (B1 floor plan, stage floor plan). Work in the hall requires a meeting with the hall staff; the detailed meeting for the day of use is held by 1 month before the day of use. Prior approval of the hall manager is required to bring in items other than the hall equipment or to install special equipment.
ops.parking: No parking lot is available for rent. Use public transportation, or if you come by car, use a nearby coin-operated parking lot.
ops.catering: Drinking alcohol, smoking, the use of open flames and bringing in dangerous items are prohibited on the stage, around it and in the seating area. (Usage Rules)
